deliverables.description: Optional. Repo-relative paths trail_runtime.py's check command verifies against the real filesystem, independent of this frame's own verdict claim.

deliverables_verification.description: Written by trail_runtime.py, not the Checker - present only when 'deliverables' was supplied.

claimed_verdict.description: Written by trail_runtime.py only when it overrides this frame's verdict because a claimed deliverable was missing - preserves the original claim for the record.

deliverables_override_note.description: Written by trail_runtime.py only alongside a claimed_verdict override, explaining which deliverable(s) were missing.
